recipes.name: Ultimate Broiled Potatoes
ingredients: Kosher salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Turn the oven to broil on the high setting. Slice the potatoes into ¼ inch rounds.
Toss sliced potatoes in vegetable oil and season with kosher salt and pepper.
Place potatoes onto a parchment-lined baking tray. Broil the potatoes for 4-6 minutes, then flip and broil for an additional 4-6 minutes.
